No se puede restaurar si la habitación de ese registro está tomada por otra reserva en esas fechas o está fuera de servicio, ni si el registro es igual al estado actual. Los cargos adicionales y los pagos no se modifican; si la reserva estaba en curso, el estado de las habitaciones se acomoda solo (la que se deja queda en limpieza y la restaurada, ocupada).

pasos: Abrí "Bitácora de reservas" desde la sección ANÁLISIS del menú lateral.
Escribí el código de reserva o un nombre de huésped o número de habitación, y si querés elegí una operación y un rango de fechas.
Presioná "Aplicar" (o Enter en los campos de texto) para ver los registros.
Marcá "Solo activos" para ver únicamente el estado actual de cada reserva.
Seleccioná un registro para ver en el panel derecho qué datos cambiaron; "Limpiar" quita todos los filtros.
Para ver el historial completo de una reserva, seleccioná uno de sus registros y presioná "Ver historial".
Para recuperar un registro anterior (rollback), seleccionalo, presioná "Restaurar como activo" y confirmá. El historial de la reserva se vuelve a mostrar con el registro nuevo seleccionado.

elementos.texto: Número de la reserva (solo admite dígitos). Debe ser mayor a cero.
Busca por nombre o apellido del titular o por número o tipo de habitación.
Muestra solo los registros de una operación (por ejemplo, Cancelación o Check-in). "Todas" no filtra.
Limitan los registros por la fecha del cambio. La fecha inicial no puede ser posterior a la final.
Al marcarlo muestra solo el registro vigente de cada reserva (su estado actual). Se aplica al instante.
Vuelve a consultar la bitácora con los filtros elegidos.
Borra todos los filtros y muestra todos los registros.

Un renglón por cada alta o cambio de cada reserva, del más nuevo al más viejo. La operación se colorea (verde alta y check-in, rojo cancelación y no-show, dorado upgrade y renovación, azul check-out y cambios de habitación, naranja modificación). El rollback se muestra en violeta.
Dato por dato, el valor en el registro anterior de la reserva (Antes) y en el seleccionado (Después). Los datos que cambiaron se resaltan.
Muestra la cantidad de registros o, con uno seleccionado, si es el estado actual de la reserva o uno anterior.
Muestra todos los registros de la reserva seleccionada (su historial de cambios), quitando los demás filtros.

Rollback: vuelve a poner como estado actual de la reserva el registro anterior seleccionado. Pide confirmación y deja en la bitácora un registro nuevo "Rollback". Solo lo ven el Administrador y los Supervisores (permiso de rollback).
Cierra la bitácora.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para ver la bitácora de reservas.

Los registros no se borran ni se editan: los cambios se hacen desde Reservas, Check-In, Check-Out, Cambio de habitación o Renovar estadía, y quedan registrados solos. El rollback tampoco pisa la historia: agrega un registro nuevo.
Un registro con usuario "Fuera del sistema" indica que alguien modificó la reserva directamente en la base: revisalo con el administrador.

temas.resumen: Agrupa las herramientas del sistema: usuarios, bitácora de auditoría, roles y familias de permisos, respaldos de la base de datos y resolución de inconsistencias.

parrafos: El botón "Administrativo" del menú lateral (grupo SISTEMA) abre el menú con Gestión de Usuarios, Bitácora, Gestión de Accesos (Roles y Familias) y Gestión de Respaldos. La pantalla de Inconsistencias de la base de datos no está en el menú: aparece al ingresar al sistema si se detectan modificaciones directas sobre la base.
Son pantallas pensadas para el administrador; cada opción se muestra solo si tenés el permiso correspondiente.

temas.resumen: Permite consultar, crear y modificar los usuarios del sistema, asignarles un rol, activarlos o desactivarlos y desbloquear cuentas bloqueadas por intentos fallidos.

parrafos: A la izquierda, la grilla de usuarios con los filtros Todos, Activos y Bloqueados y el contador "Número de usuarios". A la derecha, los datos del usuario seleccionado: DNI, Nombres, Apellidos, Email, Rol, Username, Bloqueado y Activo, y los botones de acción.

La pantalla trabaja en tres modos que se indican en el recuadro de mensaje: Modo Consulta (al seleccionar una fila se ven sus datos), Modo Inserción (al presionar "Crear") y Modo edición (al presionar "Modificar").

Al crear un usuario se cargan DNI, Nombres, Apellidos, Email y Rol. El sistema genera el Username uniendo DNI y nombre, y una contraseña inicial formada por DNI y apellido; en su primer ingreso el usuario debe cambiarla.

Al modificar solo se pueden cambiar el Email y el Rol. "Activar/Desactivar" alterna si el usuario puede ingresar. "Desbloquear" habilita una cuenta bloqueada (tras 3 intentos fallidos en 2 horas) y le restablece la contraseña inicial. No podés modificar tu propio rol, email ni estado.

pasos: Abrí Gestión de Usuarios desde el botón "Administrativo".
Para crear: presioná "Crear", completá DNI (solo números), Nombres, Apellidos, Email y Rol, y presioná "Aplicar".
Para modificar: seleccioná el usuario, presioná "Modificar", cambiá Email o Rol y presioná "Aplicar".
"Cancelar" descarta la operación y vuelve al Modo Consulta.
Para habilitar o deshabilitar un usuario, seleccionalo y presioná "Activar" o "Desactivar".
Si un usuario quedó bloqueado, filtrá "Bloqueados", seleccionalo, presioná "Desbloquear" y comunicale que ingrese con la contraseña inicial.

elementos.texto: Lista los usuarios con sus datos, rol y estados. Al seleccionar una fila se cargan sus datos a la derecha y se habilitan los botones que correspondan.
Muestran todos los usuarios, solo los activos o solo los bloqueados.
Cantidad de usuarios que muestra la grilla con el filtro actual.
Datos personales del usuario, obligatorios al crearlo. El DNI solo admite números y no puede repetirse. No se pueden modificar después.
Correo del usuario; obligatorio y con formato válido. Es uno de los dos datos que se pueden modificar.
Rol que define los permisos del usuario. Obligatorio; se puede cambiar en modo edición.
Datos de solo lectura: el nombre de usuario generado por el sistema y los estados actuales de la cuenta.
"Crear" limpia los campos y pasa a Modo Inserción; "Modificar" pasa a Modo edición con el usuario seleccionado. Cada uno requiere su permiso.
"Aplicar" valida los datos (campos completos, email y DNI válidos) y guarda el alta o la modificación. "Cancelar" vuelve al Modo Consulta sin guardar.
Habilitado solo si el usuario seleccionado está bloqueado. Pide confirmación, lo desbloquea y le restablece la contraseña inicial (DNI + apellido).
Alterna el estado activo del usuario seleccionado previa confirmación. En rojo indica Desactivar y en verde Activar.
El recuadro indica si estás en Modo Consulta, Inserción o edición. "Salir" cierra la pantalla.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para ver usuarios; crear, modificar, activar/desactivar y desbloquear usuarios son permisos separados.
Todas las altas, cambios de rol o email, bloqueos y desbloqueos quedan registrados en la Bitácora.
Un usuario desactivado no puede ingresar aunque conozca su contraseña; usá esta opción en lugar de borrar usuarios.

temas.resumen: La pantalla "Auditoría de Eventos" muestra todo lo que se registró en el sistema (ingresos, cambios de usuarios, permisos, reservas, pagos y más) y permite filtrarlo e imprimirlo.

parrafos: Cada evento tiene el Username de quien lo realizó, el Target Username (el usuario afectado, si corresponde), la FechaHora, el Módulo (Usuarios, Login, Perfiles, Reservas, Habitaciones, Huéspedes, Pagos, Configuración o Cargos adicionales), el Evento y la Criticidad.
La criticidad se colorea: Crítico en rojo, Alto en naranja, Medio en amarillo y Bajo en verde. Al abrir la pantalla se cargan todos los eventos.

Los combos Módulo, Evento y Criticidad están relacionados: al elegir un módulo, la lista de eventos se reduce a los de ese módulo (y a la criticidad elegida); al elegir un evento se completan solos su módulo y su criticidad.
El rango de fechas necesita ambas fechas, ninguna puede ser posterior a hoy y Desde no puede ser posterior a Hasta.

pasos: Abrí Bitácora desde el botón "Administrativo".
Escribí el username (o parte) de quien hizo la acción y/o del usuario afectado.
Elegí el rango de fechas Desde y Hasta.
Elegí Módulo, Evento o Criticidad según lo que busques.
Presioná "Filtrar" para ver los resultados.
Presioná "Exportar" para imprimir la grilla (o guardarla en PDF eligiendo esa impresora); "Limpiar" vuelve a mostrar todo.

elementos.texto: Usuario que realizó la acción. Podés escribir solo una parte del nombre.
Usuario sobre el que se realizó la acción (por ejemplo, el usuario desbloqueado o modificado). Admite una parte del nombre.
Desde y Hasta deben completarse juntas, no pueden ser posteriores a hoy y Desde no puede ser posterior a Hasta.
Área del sistema del evento. Al elegirlo se acota la lista de eventos.
Tipo de evento (por ejemplo inicio de sesión fallido o usuario bloqueado). Al elegirlo se completan su módulo y su criticidad.
Gravedad del evento: Crítico, Alto, Medio o Bajo. Filtra también la lista de eventos.
Valida las fechas y muestra los eventos que cumplen todos los filtros.
Borra todos los filtros y recarga la bitácora completa.
Imprime en hoja apaisada los eventos de la grilla; podés elegir una impresora de PDF para guardarlo. Avisa si la grilla está vacía.
Muestra los eventos con usuario, usuario afectado, fecha y hora, módulo, evento y criticidad coloreada.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para ver la bitácora.
Para investigar un bloqueo de cuenta, filtrá por el Target Username o el Username y el módulo Login.
La bitácora es de solo lectura: ningún usuario puede modificar ni borrar eventos desde el sistema.

temas.resumen: Administra los permisos del sistema: las familias agrupan permisos (y otras familias) y los roles combinan familias y permisos para asignarse a los usuarios.

parrafos: Se abre desde "Administrativo" › "Gestión de Accesos" › Roles o Familias; el título indica "Gestión de Roles" o "Gestión de Familias". A la izquierda está el Listado y a la derecha el Detalle: un árbol con todo lo que contiene el elemento seleccionado (📁 familias y 🔑 permisos).
Abajo están los botones Crear, Modificar y Eliminar. No se puede eliminar un rol o una familia en uso (por ejemplo, un rol asignado a usuarios o una familia incluida en un rol).

Tiene el Nombre, la lista de Asignados (lo que contiene el rol o la familia), la lista de Disponibles y el Detalle del Seleccionado, que muestra el árbol de una familia o la descripción de un permiso. Los botones Agregar y Eliminar pasan componentes de una lista a la otra.

El sistema evita permisos repetidos: en Disponibles solo aparece lo que aporta permisos nuevos; si agregás una familia que ya contiene permisos asignados sueltos, te propone reemplazarlos; y si genera conflicto con permisos de otra familia, no la deja agregar. Al guardar, el nombre no puede repetirse, debe haber al menos un permiso o familia y no puede existir otra configuración con exactamente los mismos permisos.

pasos: Abrí "Administrativo" › "Gestión de Accesos" y elegí Roles o Familias.
Seleccioná un elemento del Listado para ver su contenido en el Detalle.
Presioná "Crear" (o seleccioná uno y presioná "Modificar").
Escribí el Nombre.
Elegí componentes en Disponibles y presioná "Agregar"; para quitar, seleccionalos en Asignados y presioná "Eliminar".
Revisá el Detalle del Seleccionado para confirmar qué permisos incluye cada componente.
Presioná "Guardar"; si preferís descartar, "Cancelar".

elementos.texto: Roles o familias existentes con su nombre y tipo. Al seleccionar uno se muestra su contenido en el Detalle.
Muestra en forma de árbol las familias (📁) y permisos (🔑) que contiene el rol o la familia seleccionada.
Abren la ventana de alta o la de modificación del elemento seleccionado. Requieren el permiso de crear o modificar roles o familias, según la pantalla.
En la gestión, elimina el rol o la familia seleccionada previa confirmación (no se puede si está en uso). En la ventana de alta y modificación, quita de Asignados el componente seleccionado.
Nombre del rol o de la familia. Obligatorio y único entre roles y familias.
Permisos y familias que forman parte del rol o la familia que estás editando.
Permisos y familias que todavía se pueden agregar. Solo aparecen los que suman algún permiso que aún no está cubierto.
Pasa a Asignados el componente seleccionado en Disponibles. Puede sugerir un reemplazo o rechazarlo si generaría permisos repetidos.
Para un permiso muestra su descripción; para una familia, el árbol de lo que contiene.
"Guardar" valida y graba el rol o la familia; "Cancelar" cierra sin guardar.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para ver roles o ver familias; crear, modificar y eliminar son permisos aparte para cada uno.
Si modificás los permisos de tu propio rol, tu sesión se invalida y tenés que volver a ingresar.
Armá familias por área de trabajo (por ejemplo, Recepción o Room service) y combinalas en roles: es más fácil de mantener que asignar permisos sueltos.

temas.resumen: Crea copias de seguridad de la base de datos del hotel y permite restaurar una anterior, con el listado de los respaldos guardados en la carpeta elegida.

parrafos: La tarjeta de la izquierda muestra la Carpeta de destino (por defecto C:\HorizonHotel\Backups) y su estado: el sistema la valida al elegirla (que exista o pueda crearse, que la ruta no sea demasiado larga, que haya espacio y que el servidor de base de datos pueda escribir allí). Una carpeta de red se acepta con advertencia.

También muestra el nombre que tendrá el archivo, con la fecha y hora (por ejemplo TP_Ing_Soft_AAAAMMDD_HHMMSS.bak). Al terminar, se informa el resultado y el nuevo respaldo aparece seleccionado en el listado.

La tarjeta de la derecha permite elegir un archivo .bak (con "Examinar" o con doble clic en el listado) y muestra su nombre, tamaño y fecha. Restaurar reemplaza toda la base de datos actual por el contenido del respaldo: los cambios posteriores se pierden, no se puede deshacer y el sistema se reinicia al terminar.
Abajo, "Respaldos guardados" lista los archivos de la carpeta con Fecha, Archivo, Tamaño y Antigüedad, y un resumen con la cantidad y el espacio total.

pasos: Abrí Gestión de Respaldos desde el botón "Administrativo".
Verificá la Carpeta de destino o presioná "Cambiar" para elegir otra y esperá la validación.
Presioná "Crear respaldo" y leé el resultado.
Para restaurar, hacé doble clic en un respaldo del listado o presioná "Examinar" y elegí el archivo .bak.
Revisá el nombre, tamaño y fecha del archivo elegido.
Presioná "Restaurar este respaldo" y confirmá; el sistema se reinicia al finalizar.

elementos.texto: Carpeta donde se guarda el respaldo. "Cambiar" abre el selector de carpetas; requiere permiso para realizar respaldos.
Resultado de la validación: verde si es válida, amarillo si es una advertencia (por ejemplo carpeta de red) y rojo si no se puede usar.
Vista previa del nombre que tendrá el respaldo, formado por el nombre de la base y la fecha y hora.
Genera la copia de seguridad en la carpeta elegida. Se habilita solo con una carpeta válida y el permiso para realizar respaldos.
Mensaje en verde o rojo con el resultado del último respaldo o del intento de restauración.
Archivo .bak elegido para restaurar. "Examinar" abre el selector de archivos; requiere permiso para restaurar.
Nombre, tamaño y fecha de modificación del respaldo elegido, para confirmar que es el correcto.
Recuerda que restaurar reemplaza toda la base de datos, no se puede deshacer y reinicia el sistema.
Pide confirmación (con "No" por defecto) y restaura la base desde el archivo elegido; luego reinicia la aplicación.
Lista los .bak de la carpeta con fecha, archivo, tamaño y antigüedad. Doble clic o Enter sobre uno lo elige como archivo a restaurar.
"Abrir carpeta" muestra la carpeta en el Explorador de Windows; "Actualizar" vuelve a leer el listado de respaldos.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para ver respaldos; crear un respaldo y restaurar son permisos separados.
Hacé un respaldo antes de cambios importantes (por ejemplo, antes de restaurar otro) y guardá una copia fuera del equipo.
Avisá a los demás usuarios antes de restaurar: la base completa vuelve al estado del respaldo y la aplicación se reinicia.

temas.titulo: Inconsistencias de la base de datos
temas.resumen: Ventana que aparece al ingresar al sistema cuando se detectan modificaciones directas sobre la base de datos (hechas por fuera de la aplicación) y permite resolverlas.

parrafos: Al iniciar sesión, el sistema verifica los dígitos verificadores que protegen los datos. Si no coinciden, significa que alguien modificó la base por fuera del sistema y no se permite el ingreso.
Si tu rol tiene el permiso para manejar inconsistencias, se abre esta ventana; si no, solo se muestra un aviso para contactar a un administrador.
Recalcular acepta los datos actuales como correctos y vuelve a calcular los dígitos verificadores, sin revertir los cambios; después podés volver a iniciar sesión.
Restaurar reemplaza toda la base por un respaldo .bak que elijas (se muestran su nombre, tamaño y fecha antes de confirmar) y reinicia el sistema. Salir cierra la aplicación sin resolver nada.

pasos: Leé el mensaje y averiguá, si podés, qué cambio se hizo sobre la base.
Si los datos actuales son correctos, presioná "Recalcular" y confirmá.
Si los datos fueron alterados, presioná "Restaurar" y elegí el último respaldo confiable.
Revisá el nombre, tamaño y fecha del archivo y confirmá; el sistema se reinicia.
Volvé a iniciar sesión.

elementos.texto: Indica que se detectaron modificaciones directas sobre la base de datos y que hay que elegir una acción.
Acepta los datos actuales y normaliza los dígitos verificadores, previa confirmación. Al terminar se cierra la ventana y podés volver a ingresar.
Permite elegir un archivo de respaldo .bak, muestra sus datos, pide confirmación y restaura la base completa; luego reinicia el sistema.
Cierra la aplicación sin resolver la inconsistencia.

consejos: Necesitás el permiso para manejar inconsistencias; sin él solo verás un aviso para contactar a un administrador.
Recalcular deja como válidos cambios que podrían ser indebidos: usalo solo si sabés qué se modificó y por qué.
Mantené respaldos periódicos: son la única forma de volver atrás una modificación no autorizada.

temas.resumen: Agrupa las opciones de tu propia cuenta: cambiar la contraseña, volver a ingresar (ReLogin) y cerrar la sesión.

parrafos: Se accede con el botón "Mi perfil" del menú lateral o haciendo clic en la tarjeta con tus iniciales, nombre y rol. El menú tiene Cambiar Contraseña, Relogin y Cerrar Sesión. Además, el botón "Cerrar sesión" al pie del menú lateral cierra la sesión directamente.
Estas opciones están disponibles para todos los usuarios, sin permisos especiales.

temas.resumen: Permite reemplazar tu contraseña por una nueva. Es obligatorio hacerlo en el primer ingreso o después de que un administrador desbloquee tu cuenta.

parrafos: Podés abrirla cuando quieras desde "Mi perfil" › "Cambiar Contraseña". El sistema también la abre sola al ingresar si todavía tenés la contraseña inicial (DNI + apellido), que se asigna al crear el usuario y al desbloquearlo.
Después de cambiarla, la sesión se cierra y tenés que volver a ingresar con la contraseña nueva.

Los tres campos son obligatorios, la nueva contraseña y la confirmación deben coincidir, la nueva no puede ser igual a la actual y la contraseña actual debe ser la correcta. El cambio queda registrado en la Bitácora.

pasos: Abrí "Mi perfil" y elegí "Cambiar Contraseña".
Escribí tu Contraseña Actual.
Escribí la Nueva Contraseña y repetila en Confirmar Contraseña (con el ícono del ojo podés mostrarlas u ocultarlas).
Presioná "Cambiar Contraseña".
Cuando aparezca "Contraseña Cambiada", volvé a ingresar con la contraseña nueva.

elementos.texto: Tu contraseña vigente. Si es incorrecta, el cambio se rechaza.
La contraseña que vas a usar desde ahora; no puede ser igual a la actual. El ícono del ojo muestra u oculta este campo y el de confirmación a la vez.
Repetí la nueva contraseña; debe coincidir exactamente.
Valida los tres campos y guarda la nueva contraseña. Si sale bien, cierra la ventana y la sesión para que ingreses de nuevo.

consejos: No necesitás ningún permiso especial: cada usuario puede cambiar su propia contraseña.
Usá una contraseña que no se pueda deducir de tus datos (evitá DNI, nombre o apellido).
Si olvidaste tu contraseña, pedile a un administrador que te desbloquee: volverás a la contraseña inicial y deberás cambiarla.

temas.resumen: Explica cómo cerrar tu sesión de forma segura y qué hace la opción Relogin del menú Mi perfil.

parrafos: Podés cerrar la sesión con el botón "Cerrar sesión" al pie del menú lateral o con "Mi perfil" › "Cerrar Sesión". El sistema pide confirmación, registra la salida en la Bitácora, guarda el idioma que estabas usando para tu próximo ingreso y vuelve a la pantalla de ingreso.
Cerrar la ventana principal con la X también cierra la sesión. La sesión se cierra sola después de cambiar la contraseña y cuando modificás los permisos de tu propio rol (sesión invalidada).

"Mi perfil" › "Relogin" abre la ventana de ingreso sin cerrar la ventana principal. Como el sistema admite una sola sesión activa a la vez, si intentás ingresar mientras tu sesión sigue abierta se muestra el aviso "Ya hay una sesión activa. Cierre la sesión actual antes de iniciar otra."
Para entrar con otro usuario, primero cerrá la sesión actual. La X de la ventana de Relogin solo cierra esa ventana, sin salir de la aplicación.

pasos: Guardá o terminá lo que estés haciendo en la pantalla actual.
Presioná "Cerrar sesión" al pie del menú lateral (o "Mi perfil" › "Cerrar Sesión").
Confirmá con "Sí".
En la pantalla de ingreso, entrá con el usuario que corresponda.

elementos.texto: Pide confirmación, cierra tu sesión y vuelve a la pantalla de ingreso.

consejos: Cerrá siempre la sesión al dejar el puesto: todo lo que se haga con tu usuario queda registrado a tu nombre en la Bitácora.
Si cambiaste el idioma durante la sesión, se recordará para tu próximo ingreso.

temas.resumen: The basics to start working with the Horizon Hotel & Resort management system: how to log in, what the home screen shows, how to move around the menu and how to get help.

parrafos: Logging in: how to start a session with your username and password, and what to do if the account gets locked or asks you to change the password.

Home screen and Main menu: the summary of the day at the hotel, the quick access buttons and the side bar from which every screen is opened. How to use help: context help with F1, the "What's this?" mode and the PDF manual.

consejos: What you see in the system depends on your role's permissions: if a button or option is missing, ask an administrator for access.

temas.resumen: This is the first screen of the system: you enter your username and password to open a work session. Only authorized hotel staff can access it.

parrafos: The hotel brand is shown on the left. On the right is the login form with the Username and Password fields and the Log in button. At the top right you can choose the screen language and minimize or close the application.
Once you log in, the system opens in the language saved in your profile and shows the home screen.

secciones.titulo: What the system checks when you log in
parrafos: If the password is wrong, you are warned that after 3 failed attempts the account is locked. A locked or disabled account cannot log in until an administrator unlocks or re-enables it.
If you are still using the default password, the system asks you to change it before continuing; after changing it you have to log in again with the new password.

Before the session opens, the database integrity is verified. If an inconsistency is detected, only a user with permission to handle it can go in and repair it; everyone else is told to contact an administrator.

pasos: Type your username in the Username field.
Type your password in the Password field. To check what you typed, click the eye icon.
If the "Caps Lock is on" warning appears, turn caps lock off: the password is case sensitive.
Press Log in (or the Enter key).
If the system asks you to change the password, complete the change and log in again with the new password.

elementos.texto: Your username in the system. It is required: if you leave it empty you are asked to fill in the fields.
Your password. It is hidden while you type; the eye icon on the right shows or hides it. After 3 failed attempts the account is locked.
Appears when Caps Lock is on, so you do not type your password in capitals by mistake.
Validates the username and password and opens the session. The Enter key does the same. If a session is already open, it must be closed first.
Switches the screen language between Spanish and English. Once inside the system, the language saved in your profile is used.
Minimize the window or close the application.

consejos: If the account was locked after failed attempts, ask an administrator to unlock it from User management.
Do not share your user: every operation (bookings, payments, check-in, etc.) is recorded under the name of whoever opened the session.

temas.resumen: It is the first thing you see after logging in and where the Home button takes you: a greeting, the date, the day's activity at the hotel and shortcuts to your most frequent tasks.

parrafos: At the top you see a greeting with your name and today's date. Below is the "TODAY AT THE HOTEL" block with four indicators, and the "QUICK ACCESS" block with buttons that open the tasks you are allowed to do.

The indicators are shown to users who work with the front desk or the dashboard (Dashboard, Room control, Check-In or Check-Out permissions). If the database cannot be reached, the screen still opens but without the day's activity.
ARRIVALS TODAY: bookings arriving today and how many are still waiting for check-in. DEPARTURES TODAY: stays ending today and how many still need check-out.
GUESTS IN HOUSE: number of people at the hotel and stays in progress. CURRENT OCCUPANCY: percentage of occupied rooms over the total.

pasos: Check the TODAY AT THE HOTEL block to see how many arrivals and departures are still pending.
Click a quick access button (for example Check-In or New booking) to open that task.
To refresh the figures, press Home in the side menu again.

elementos.texto: Four cards with the day's activity: arrivals (and pending check-ins), departures (and pending check-outs), guests in house with the stays in progress, and current occupancy. The data is read when the screen opens.
Buttons that go straight to New booking, Check-In, Check-Out, Room control, Room service order, Pending orders, Dashboard or Reports. Only the ones your role allows are shown.

consejos: If you do not see a quick access button or the TODAY AT THE HOTEL block, your role does not have the corresponding permission.
The figures are a snapshot of the moment you opened the screen: they do not refresh on their own.

temas.resumen: This is the main window of the system: a top bar with the current section, the clock, the language and help, and a side menu from which every screen is opened.

parrafos: The side menu groups the options into OPERATIONS (Front Desk, Reservations, Guests, Room service), HOTEL (Rooms, Hotel settings), ANALYTICS (Dashboard, Reports, Reservation change log) and SYSTEM (Administrative, My profile). Above the menu is your user card with your initials, name and role; at the bottom, the Log out button.
The chosen screen opens in the central area. The active section button is highlighted with a background and a golden bar, and the top bar reads "Section › Screen".
The buttons with a submenu (Front Desk, Room service, Rooms, Administrative and My profile) open their options when clicked.
Only the buttons and options your role allows are shown; a group with no visible options is hidden entirely.
While the window is open, every 15 minutes the system automatically cancels no-show bookings: pending bookings whose check-in time plus the configured grace hours has already passed.
If an administrator changes the permissions of your own role, the session is invalidated and you have to log in again.

pasos: Click a button in the side menu; if it has a submenu, choose the option you need.
Work on the screen that opens in the central area; the top bar reminds you which section you are in.
To go back to the day's summary, press Home.
To change the language, use the selector in the top bar: the change applies immediately and is saved in your profile.
When you finish, press Log out and confirm.

elementos.texto: Shows the home screen with the day's activity and quick access buttons.
Opens Booking, Room control, Check-In, Check-Out and Room change (depending on your permissions).
Open the reservation list and calendar, and the guest master list.
Opens New order, Room service orders and Room service menu.
Rooms opens Rooms, Room types and Floors. Hotel settings opens the check-in/check-out times and the grace hours.

elementos.nombre: Dashboard and Reports and Reservation change log
elementos.texto: Open the hotel indicators and report generation. Reservation change log shows every new reservation and every change to it.
Opens User management, Audit log, Access management (Roles and Families) and Backup management.
Show your name and role. Clicking opens the My profile menu: Change password, ReLogin and Log out.
Asks for confirmation, closes your session and returns to the login screen.
Shows the system name, the current section and screen ("Section › Screen") and the date and time.
Switches the whole application between Spanish and English and saves it as your preference.
Opens the help menu: Help for this screen (F1), What's this? (Shift+F1), Help index and User manual (PDF).

consejos: If you do not see an option you need, ask an administrator to add the permission to your role.
The buttons in the top right corner minimize, maximize/restore or close the application; closing the window also closes your session.

temas.resumen: Online help is available on every screen, including pop-up windows and the login screen: you can ask for the explanation of a specific element or open the full topic of the screen.

parrafos: F1: if the mouse pointer is over an element that has help, a balloon with its explanation appears next to the pointer, with the link "View the full help for this screen". If the pointer is not over an element with help, the help window opens directly on the topic of the current screen.
Shift+F1 or "What's this?": the pointer turns into a question mark and the next click on any element shows its help. To cancel this mode press Esc or right-click.
The "?" button in the top bar gathers these options: Help for this screen (F1), What's this? (Shift+F1), Help index and User manual (PDF).

On the left is the tree-shaped index ("staircase menu") with a search box to find topics by keyword. On the right the selected topic is shown: summary, sections, steps, the screen elements, tips and links to related topics.
The "PDF manual" button generates the complete manual with a cover and a numbered stepped index (1, 1.1, 1.2...), to view, print or save as PDF.

pasos: Rest the mouse pointer over the button, field or grid you do not understand.
Press F1 and read the help balloon that appears next to the pointer.
If you need more detail, click "View the full help for this screen".
In the help window, use the index or the search box to move to other topics, or the related topic links.
To get the whole manual, press "PDF manual" and choose to view, print or save it.
consejos: If a click with "What's this?" does not show anything specific, try the control next to it or open the full help for the screen.
Help is shown in the system's active language.
Help, search and the PDF manual show only the screens and options your user is allowed to use: two users with different permissions see different content.

temas.resumen: The daily front desk tasks: checking availability and registering bookings, monitoring room status, doing check-in and check-out, extending stays and moving a guest to another room.

parrafos: Booking (availability) and Register a booking: choose dates, a free room, the main guest and collect payment for the stay. Room control: the board with every room by floor and the actions for each one.

Check-In and Check-Out: the arrival (with companions) and the departure (with the balance payment). Extend the stay and Room change: extend the check-out date, do an upgrade requested by the guest or relocate them by hotel decision.

The booking cycle is: Pending (confirmed, no check-in) → Occupied (in progress, after check-in) → Finished (after check-out). A pending booking can also become Cancelled, manually or automatically if the guest does not show up.

consejos: The Front Desk menu options depend on your permissions; Room change appears if you can register upgrades or relocate guests.

temas.resumen: This is the first step of a new booking (step 1 of 3): you choose the arrival and departure dates and how many people are staying. On the right you immediately see how many rooms of each type are free, with the rate and the estimated total for the stay.

parrafos: At the top right there is the step indicator: Dates & guests → Room → Guest & payment.

On the left there is the two-month calendar: the first click sets the arrival and the second one the departure. Below it there are quick options (tonight, weekend, 1 week, 2 weeks) that set the range at once.
On the right there is the stay summary (arrival, departure and nights), the number of adults and children and the availability by room type for those dates and that number of guests.
"Choose room" opens the rooms that are free every night of the range and can host the indicated guests. If you chose a type in the list, it opens already filtered by that type.
On that screen, "Change dates" goes back to this step with everything you had chosen. Clicking a room opens Register Reservation with the dates and guests already filled in.

pasos: In the Front Desk menu choose Booking (or the New booking quick access).
Mark the arrival and departure on the calendar, or use a quick option.
Set how many adults and children are staying.
Check the availability by type; if you want, click a type to filter the next step.
Press Choose room and click the chosen room.

elementos.texto: First click: arrival day; second click: departure day. Days before today cannot be chosen. "Clear selection" erases the range to start over.
Set the range at once: tonight (today to tomorrow), the next weekend (Friday to Sunday), one week or two weeks from today.
Shows the arrival, the departure and the number of nights, including how many fall on the weekend (Friday and Saturday).
Number of people staying. Only rooms with enough capacity are considered; the same values are carried to Register Reservation.

For each room type: how many are free on those dates (green, orange when few are left, red when it is fully booked or cannot host that many guests), the nightly rate and the estimated total. One click chooses the type to filter the next step; another click removes it.
Enabled when a full range is selected and some room is free. Opens the rooms available for those dates and that number of guests.
Shows where you are in the process: 1 Dates & guests, 2 Room, 3 Guest & payment.

consejos: You need the permission to register new bookings.
The total shown is an estimate (nightly rate × nights); the final amount is calculated when the booking is registered.
If there is no room, try other dates or fewer people per room.
You can also book from the Reservations calendar by double-clicking a free day of a room.

temas.resumen: On this screen you complete the booking for the chosen room: the main guest, the dates, the number of guests and the payment for the stay. When you confirm, the booking is registered and paid.

parrafos: At the top, the step indicator shows this is step 3 of the booking (Dates → Room → Guest and payment) and the subtitle summarizes the room, the dates and the nights.

On the left, BOOKING HOLDER: the holder is looked up by document and their details fill in automatically; below, PAYMENT. On the right, the chosen room (large number, type, description, floor, capacity and price per night) and the SUMMARY (dates, nights, adults and children) with the total to charge at the bottom.
The total is the price per night multiplied by the number of nights and is recalculated every time you change the dates. "Back" returns to step 2 with the same dates and guests.

The main guest must be registered as a guest and be of legal age (18 or older). Adults plus children cannot exceed the room capacity. The check-in date cannot be earlier than today and check-out must be at least one day later.

The full stay is charged when booking. In cash, the amount received must cover the total and the change is calculated. With a card, the number, cardholder, expiry date and CVV are validated, and the card brand is detected automatically.

When you confirm, the booking voucher and the invoice open, and you can print them or save them as PDF; the email to the guest is sent automatically in the background. If someone else took the room in the meantime, you are told it is no longer available.

pasos: Choose the document type, type the main guest's number and press Look Up Document.
If the guest does not exist, register them with the new guest button (next to Look Up Document).
Check or adjust the check-in and check-out dates.
Enter the number of adults and children.
Choose the payment method and enter the amount received (cash) or the card details.
Press Confirm Reservation.
In the voucher window, print it or save it as PDF if needed, and close it.

elementos.texto: They show which booking step you are on and summarize the room, the dates and the number of nights.
Reminds you what is missing before you can confirm (for example, looking up the holder). It disappears once the holder is loaded.
Type the document number and press Look Up Document. If the guest is registered, their data is loaded into the form; otherwise you are told it was not found.
Opens the new guest form; once saved, the guest is selected as main guest. It only appears if you have permission to register guests.
They fill in automatically after the document lookup and cannot be edited here. To correct them, use the Guests master list. The email is the one that receives the voucher.
Type, floor, description, price per night and maximum capacity of the chosen room.
They come from the chosen range and can be adjusted. If check-out ends up on or before check-in, it is automatically moved to the next day.
Number of adults and children. If the total exceeds the capacity, a warning appears and the booking cannot be confirmed.
Number of nights in the range and total amount to charge (price per night × nights).
Cash, Card or Bank transfer. In cash you enter the amount received and see the change; with the other methods the card details are requested and validated.
What the guest hands over in cash. It must be equal to or greater than the total; the change is calculated automatically. The payment recorded is the stay total, not the amount handed over.
Card number (it is validated and the detected brand is shown) and the cardholder's name as it appears on the card.
Expiry month and year (the card cannot be expired) and the security code, with the number of digits that matches the brand.
Confirm validates everything, registers the booking and the payment and opens the voucher. Cancel goes back to the room list without saving anything.

consejos: You need the permissions to register bookings and to collect payments: without either of them the Confirm Reservation button is not shown.
The main guest must be of legal age; minors travel as companions and are entered at check-in.
Companions are not entered when booking: they are registered at check-in.

temas.resumen: This is the front desk board: it shows every room grouped by floor with its current status and who is in it, and each card opens the available actions (book, check-in, check-out, room service, room change, extend, maintenance).

parrafos: At the top, the title with today's date and a row of status indicators (All, Available, Reserved, Occupied, Cleaning, Out of Service) with the count for each; clicking one filters the rooms by that status. Below, the room type buttons to filter by type.

Each card shows the number, type, status, capacity and nightly rate, and at the bottom who is staying (or who arrives today) with the dates. A free room with a booking arriving today is shown as Reserved.
When the screen is opened from Booking, it is titled "Available Rooms", shows only the rooms free for the chosen range, and clicking one goes straight to Register Reservation.

Clicking a card opens the actions window with the number, type and status. Available: Book. Reserved: Register check-in and View / Modify booking. Occupied: View stay details, Register check-out, Room service, Room change and Renew stay. Cleaning or Out of Service: Mark as Available. All except those already out of service: Put under Maintenance.

An occupied room, or one with a booking arriving today, cannot go under maintenance with the guest in it: the system first offers to relocate the stay or booking to another room at no charge, and only then puts it out of service.
After check-out the room goes to Cleaning; when it is ready, mark it as Available.

It shows the booking, main guest, room, dates and status, and every account movement: accommodation, extension, upgrades, relocations, room service orders and payments. At the bottom, the totals: accommodation, extension, additional charges, stay total, paid and balance due.
Additional charges and extensions are collected at check-out.

pasos: In the Front Desk menu choose Room control.
If you want, filter by status with the indicators at the top or by type with the room type buttons.
Click the room card.
In the actions window, choose the action you need (for example Register check-out).
Complete the screen that opens; when done you return to the updated board.
If another user made changes, press Refresh to see the latest status.

elementos.texto: Number of rooms in each status. Click one to see only the rooms in that status, or All to remove the filter.
Shows only the rooms of the chosen type; All removes the filter. It combines with the status filter.
One card per room, grouped by floor. The stripe color and the label show the status; the guest and dates are shown at the bottom. Hover to see the details and click to open the actions.
Reads the status of every room again.
In daily control it shows today's date; when booking, the chosen range and the number of nights.
Number, type and status of the room you are about to work on.
Buttons with the actions that match the room status. Only the ones your permissions allow are shown.

Each stay movement with date, concept, details and amount. Payments are shown in green as negative amounts; relocations appear as no charge. Room service orders with their items are shown to room service staff; others see the summarized charge.
Booked accommodation, extension, additional charges, total, paid and balance due (in red if something is still owed).
View invoice opens the booking invoice to print it, save it as PDF or send it by email. Close returns to the board.

consejos: You need the permission to access Room control; each action also requires its own permission (book, check-in, check-out, extend, room service, change room status, view bookings).
For a guest arriving without a booking (walk-in), first register a booking starting today with Book and then do the check-in.
Marking a Cleaning room as Available is what makes it offered again for bookings and walk-ins.

temas.resumen: Registers the guest's arrival: finds the main guest's pending booking, enters the companions and leaves the stay in progress with the room occupied.

parrafos: If you come from the menu, the Search Reservation by ID button appears first. If you come from Room control (Reserved room), the booking is already loaded.

RESERVATION DETAILS shows the room, type, main guest with their document, dates and composition (adults and children). If the booking has more than one guest, COMPANIONS appears, with one row for each expected companion.
Check-in can only be done for a Pending booking whose check-in date has arrived; if it is in the future, a red warning appears next to the dates and the Confirm button is disabled.

All companions must be identified. None of them can be the main guest or be repeated. The ages must match the booking: the main guest counts as an adult, companions aged 18 or over as adults and the rest as children.
When confirmed, the booking becomes Occupied (in progress), the room becomes Occupied and the companions are recorded in the stay.

pasos: Press Search Reservation by ID, enter the main guest's document, press Search and then Select.
Check the booking details.
In each COMPANIONS row, type the document and press the magnifying glass.
If a companion is not registered, use the person-with-plus icon to add them.
When every row shows a name and age in green, press Confirm Check-in.

elementos.texto: Opens the search by main guest document among Pending bookings.
Room, type, main guest with their document and expected composition (adults and children).
Booking check-in and check-out dates. If the check-in date has not arrived yet, it is shown in red and cannot be confirmed.
One row per companion: document, magnifying glass to search, result (name and age in green, or the problem in red) and a button to register a new guest if you have permission.
Validates companions and composition and registers the check-in. Only visible with the permission to register check-in.
Returns to Room control without registering anything.

consejos: You need the permission to register check-in; to add new companions, you also need the permission to register guests.
If the composition does not match (for example, one more adult arrives), first modify the booking from Reservations or Room control and then do the check-in.
Pending bookings that do not check in within the grace hours after the check-in time are automatically cancelled as no-shows.

temas.resumen: Registers the guest's departure: shows the full stay account, collects the balance due (extensions, upgrades and room service) and closes the booking.

parrafos: If you come from the menu, you first search the stay in progress by the main guest's document; from Room control (Occupied room) it is already loaded. RESERVATION DETAILS shows room, type, main guest, dates and composition.
BILL shows accommodation, extension, additional charges, stay total, amount paid and balance due. "View account details" shows every movement.

If there is a balance due, the payment method and amount received are requested; in cash the change is calculated. The amount received cannot be less than the balance. The payment recorded is the balance, not the amount handed over.
If there is no balance, check-out is confirmed without payment. If there are undelivered room service orders, a warning is shown next to the charges.
When confirmed, the booking becomes Finished and the room goes to Cleaning.

pasos: Press Search Reservation by ID, enter the main guest's document and select the stay in progress.
Review the bill; if the guest asks for details, open "View account details".
If there is a balance due, choose the payment method and enter the amount received.
Press Confirm Check-out.
When the room is clean, mark it as Available from Room control.

elementos.texto: Searches by main guest document among stays in progress.
Room, type, main guest, dates and composition of the stay.
Booked accommodation, extension (added nights), additional charges (upgrades and room service), stay total and total paid.
What is still owed. Red if there is a balance, green if the account is settled.
Shows how many room service orders are still undelivered; they are charged anyway because they are already on the bill.
Opens the stay details with every movement and total.
Cash, Card or Bank transfer. Only shown if there is a balance due.
What the guest hands over; it cannot be less than the balance. In cash the change is shown.
Registers the balance payment (if any) and the check-out. Visible with the check-out permission and, if there is a balance, also the collect payments permission.
Returns to Room control without registering anything.

consejos: You need the permission to register check-out; if there is a balance due, you also need the permission to collect payments.
Before confirming, it is best for service staff to mark pending orders as delivered.

temas.resumen: Extends a stay in progress by changing the check-out date. The cost of the added nights is not charged at that moment: it is added to the balance and collected at check-out.

parrafos: It opens from Room control, with the Renew stay action on an Occupied room. It shows the room, main guest, current check-out date and the current nightly rate.
When you choose the new check-out date, the additional nights and additional cost are calculated.
Only stays in progress can be extended, and the new date must be later than the current check-out. The room must be free on those nights: if another booking overlaps, it cannot be extended.
Added nights are charged at the current rate: if the guest had an upgrade, the new room's rate is used.

pasos: In Room control, click the occupied room and choose Renew stay.
Choose the new check-out date.
Check the additional nights and the additional cost.
Press Confirm.

elementos.texto: Room, main guest and current check-out date.
Current stay rate (the one from the last upgrade, if any).
It must be at least one day after the current check-out date.
Nights added and their cost (nights × current rate). It is added to the balance collected at check-out.
Registers the new check-out date. Only visible with the permission to extend stays.
Closes the window without changes.

consejos: You need the permission to renew (extend) stays.
If the room is already booked by another guest for those dates, an alternative is to move the guest to another free room.

temas.resumen: Moves a booking to another room: as an upgrade requested by the guest (charged to the bill) or as a relocation decided by the hotel (no charge).

parrafos: From the Front Desk › Room change menu: first the stay in progress is searched by the main guest's document. From Room control: Room change action on an Occupied room. It also opens when putting under maintenance a room that is occupied or has a booking arriving today (relocation only).
The search window asks for the main guest's document type and number; pressing Search shows the room, main guest, dates and composition, and Select continues.

Upgrade requested by the guest: only with the stay in progress and only to rooms with a higher rate. The charge is the nightly rate difference multiplied by the remaining nights; it is added to the bill and collected at check-out. From then on the new rate is the current one.

Relocation by the hotel: any free room with enough capacity, at no charge; the guest keeps their rate. The reason is required (at least 5 characters). A pending booking that has not checked in yet can also be relocated: it is assigned another room for the whole stay.

With the guest already staying, the move is immediate: the new room must be ready now and free until check-out, and the previous one goes to Cleaning (or out of service, if it is being put under maintenance). Every change is recorded in the Reservation change log.

pasos: Open Room change from the Front Desk menu (and search the stay by document) or from Room control.
Choose the reason: Upgrade requested by the guest or Relocation by the hotel.
Write the note (required for relocation).
Select the new room in the grid and check the calculated charge.
Press Confirm change (or double-click the room) and confirm the message.

elementos.texto: Document type and number of the main guest of the booking you are looking for.
Searches the booking in the status that matches the task (for example, in progress). The result shows room, main guest, dates and composition, or a red warning if nothing was found.
Enabled once a booking is found, and continues with it.
Current room, main guest, check-out date, remaining nights and current rate.
Upgrade requested by the guest (charged) or Relocation by the hotel (no charge). Only the reasons allowed by your permissions and the booking status are shown.
For a relocation the reason must be explained (for example "Water leak in the bathroom"); for an upgrade it is optional. Maximum 200 characters.
Rooms the booking can move to: floor, type, capacity, rate and difference per night. For an upgrade only higher-rate rooms appear. Double-click confirms.
New rate, difference per night, nights charged and charge to the bill. For a relocation it shows "No charge".
Explains how the change is applied or why it cannot be done (for example, if there are no remaining nights).
Confirm asks for confirmation and registers the change; if the room is no longer free, you are told and the list is refreshed. Cancel closes without changes.

consejos: For an upgrade you need the permission to register room upgrades; for a relocation, the permission to relocate guests.
An upgrade cannot be registered on the check-out day (there are no nights left to charge).
The new room must have capacity for every guest on the booking.

temas.resumen: Gathers every hotel booking in a filterable list and in a calendar by room. From here you can create, modify, cancel and print bookings and see their voucher and invoice.

parrafos: At the top there are five cards with the amount and number of bookings: ACTIVE VALUE (pending and occupied), PENDING, OCCUPIED, FINISHED and CANCELLED; they follow the filters applied.

The grid shows code, guest with document, room, who registered it and when, check-in, check-out, cost (accommodation plus additional charges), paid amount, balance and status. At the end of each row are the Edit, Print and Cancel icons.
Statuses: Pending (confirmed, no check-in), Occupied (in progress), Finished and Cancelled. Only Pending bookings can be modified or cancelled.

One row per room (grouped by floor) and one column per day. Each booking is a bar that starts at the check-in time on the arrival day and ends at the check-out time on departure (or at the actual time, if it already happened). The occupancy of each night is shown at the top; out-of-service rooms appear striped.
Clicking a booking opens its voucher and invoice. Double-clicking a free day (from today on) opens Register Reservation for that room from that day, for one night.

Modify Reservation lets you change the dates and the number of adults and children of a Pending booking; it recalculates nights and total amount. If the new amount exceeds what was paid, the difference becomes a balance collected at check-out.
The document viewer shows the booking voucher and the invoice in tabs, with the Save PDF, Print, Send by email and Close buttons. The email sending status is shown in the header.

pasos: Open Reservations in the side menu.
Fill in the filters you need (guest, room, status, dates, cost) and press Filter.
To modify a pending booking, click the Edit icon on its row, change dates or composition and press Save.
To print the invoice, click the Print icon and use Print, Save PDF or Send by email.
To cancel a pending booking, click the Cancel icon and confirm.
To see occupancy over time, switch to the Calendar tab and navigate by week or month.

elementos.texto: Opens the date selection to register a new booking. Requires the permission to register bookings.
Switch between the filterable list and the calendar by room.
Amount and number of bookings by status according to the filters applied. ACTIVE VALUE adds pending and occupied ones.
Guest (first name, last name or document), room number, receptionist who registered it and status.
Check-in and check-out date ranges. The "from" date cannot be later than the "to" date.
Any, Greater than, Less than or Between; depending on the option, one or two amounts are requested.
Filter applies the filters; Clear removes them and shows every booking.
One row per booking. Icons at the end: Edit (pending only, with modify permission), Print (opens the invoice, with print voucher permission) and Cancel (pending only, with cancel permission).
Booking bars by room and day. Click a bar: voucher and invoice. Double-click a free day: new booking (with permissions to book and collect payment).
Single arrows move one day and double arrows one week or month; Today returns to the current period; Week and Month change the view. The period shown is displayed at the top.
New dates (check-in from today, later check-out) and number of adults and children; nights and amount are recalculated. If the composition exceeds the capacity a warning is shown.
Save checks capacity and availability for the new range and applies the change; Cancel closes without changes.

consejos: You need the permission to view bookings; editing, printing and cancelling each require their own permission.
Cancelling a booking cannot be undone and is only possible before check-in.
Pending bookings that do not show up are cancelled automatically as no-shows after the configured grace hours.
To change the room of a pending booking, use Room change (relocation).

temas.resumen: This is the guest master list: it lists registered people with filters, and lets you add, modify and delete them and export or import the list as XML.

parrafos: At the top, the New guest button. Below, the filters: first name, last name, document, document type, nationality, email, phone and age (any, greater than, less than or between). The grid shows last name, first name, document type and number, nationality, date of birth, age, phone and email, with the Edit and Delete icons.
At most 500 results are shown; if that limit is reached, a notice asks you to narrow the search with the filters.

The Register Guest (or Edit guest) window requires first name, last name, document type and number, nationality and date of birth; phone and email are optional, but the email must have a valid format. The date of birth cannot be in the future.
The same guest cannot be registered twice (same document, type and nationality). The same window is used from Register Reservation and from Check-In to add main guests and companions.
A guest can only be deleted if they do not appear in any booking (neither as main guest nor as companion, including history); otherwise the icon is dimmed.
Serialize saves the guests shown in the grid to an XML file. Deserialize loads an XML file into the grid only for viewing: it does not change the database. Filter or Clear return to the real list.

pasos: Open Guests in the side menu.
Fill in one or more filters and press Filter.
To add a guest, press New guest, fill in the data and press Register.
To correct data, click the Edit icon on the row, make the changes and press Save.
To delete, click the Delete icon and confirm (only guests without bookings).

elementos.texto: Opens the new guest form. Requires the permission to register guests.
Filter by guest data; you can combine several. They are applied when you press Filter.
Any, greater than, less than or between; depending on the option, one or two ages are requested.
Filter searches with the filters; Clear removes them and reloads the full list from the database (it also discards any XML you are viewing).
One row per guest. Edit icon (with modify permission) and Delete icon (with delete permission; dimmed if the guest has bookings).
Shows that only the first 500 results are displayed; use the filters to narrow the search.
Saves the guests shown in the grid to an XML file; you choose the folder and name. Requires its permission.
Shows a guest XML file in the grid, with a notice that the data does not come from the database. Nothing is saved. Requires its permission.
Required.
Type (National ID, Passport, ID card or Other), number and nationality; required. Together they identify the guest and cannot be repeated.
Date of birth is required (not in the future; it defines whether the guest is an adult or a child). Phone and email are optional; the email receives the booking vouchers.
Validates and saves the guest (new or edited); Cancel closes without saving.

consejos: You need the permission to access the guest master list; creating, modifying, deleting, serializing and deserializing each require their own permission.
Check the date of birth: the system uses it to require that the main guest is of legal age and to count adults and children at check-in.

temas.resumen: Room service: charging orders to the bill of a stay in progress, tracking and confirming their delivery, and keeping the menu of products and prices.

parrafos: New order: the front desk enters what the guest orders; the amount is added to the room bill and collected at check-out. Room service orders: the service staff screen with pending orders and waiting time, where delivery is confirmed. Room service menu: adding, editing and deactivating items.
Each item's price is fixed when the order is placed: if the menu changes later, orders already entered do not change.

consejos: Orders can only be charged to stays in progress (checked in).

temas.resumen: Charges a room service order to the bill of a stay in progress: you choose the menu items and quantities, and the total is collected at check-out.

parrafos: From the Room service › New order menu, the stay in progress is first searched by the main guest's document; from Room control (Occupied room › Room service) it opens directly.

At the top you see the room, main guest, check-out date and the charges already on the bill. On the left is the menu (active items only) with a search box; on the right, the order with quantities, subtotals and total.
Each item allows up to 20 units per order and the order must have at least one item. The amount is calculated with the current menu prices.
Once registered, the order becomes Pending in the service staff list and its amount is added to the bill. If an item was deactivated while you were building the order, you are told and it is removed.

pasos: Open New order from the Room service menu (and search the stay by document) or from Room control.
Find the item in the menu by typing part of its name or description.
Double-click the item (or the + button) to add it to the order.
Adjust quantities with + and −, or remove an item with the trash can.
Press Register order and confirm the amount.

elementos.texto: Room, main guest, check-out date and total additional charges already on the bill.
Filters the menu as you type, by name or description.
Active items with description and price. Double-click or the + button adds one unit to the order.
Chosen items with quantity and subtotal. − and + buttons change the quantity (maximum 20 per item) and the trash can removes it.
Sum of the subtotals. It is charged to the room bill and collected at check-out.
Enabled with at least one item. Asks for confirmation with the amount and registers the order.
Closes the window without registering the order.

consejos: You need the permission to register room service orders.
Orders are not paid at that moment: they appear on the stay bill and are settled at check-out.

temas.resumen: This is the service staff screen: it shows pending orders with how long they have been waiting and lets you confirm their delivery. It refreshes itself every minute.

parrafos: At the top, the Pending, Delivered today and All filters, the room field and the Filter, Clear and Refresh buttons. Below, a summary with the number of pending orders, how long the oldest has waited and the time of the last refresh.

The grid shows order, room, guest, item details, order time, waiting time, status and amount. Waiting time is shown in yellow and turns red from 30 minutes; delivered orders are shown in green with the delivery time.
The double check icon on each pending order confirms delivery (with its permission). Double-clicking a row shows the details: items, subtotals, amount and who entered it.
"Delivered today" uses the delivery time: an order from last night delivered today also appears.

pasos: Open Room service › Room service orders (or the Pending orders quick access).
Keep the filter on Pending to see what still needs delivering, starting with the ones in red.
If you want, type a room number and press Filter (or Enter).
When you deliver an order, click the double check icon on its row and confirm.

elementos.texto: Pending (not delivered), Delivered today or All. Changing the option reloads the list.
Shows only that room's orders. Enter applies the filter.
Filter applies the room; Clear removes it and goes back to Pending.
Reads the orders again right away (the screen also refreshes itself every minute while it is open).
Number of pending orders, waiting time of the oldest and time of the last refresh. Red if any exceeds 30 minutes.
One order per row. The double check icon confirms delivery of a pending order; double-click shows the details.

consejos: You need the permission to confirm delivery of room service orders.
Confirm delivery as soon as the order is delivered: this way the waiting time is accurate and the front desk sees an up-to-date bill at check-out.

temas.resumen: Manages the items offered in room service: name, description and price. Items are not deleted: they are deactivated and are no longer offered.

parrafos: At the top, the New item button and the filters (name or description and "Show inactive items"). The grid shows name, description, price and status (active or inactive), with the Edit and Activate/Deactivate icons.
The item window asks for the name (required, up to 100 characters and unique), the description (optional, up to 200), the unit price (greater than zero) and whether it is available on the menu.
Deactivating an item removes it from the menu for new orders; orders that already include it do not change. You can activate it again whenever you want.
Changing a price only affects new orders: each order keeps the price from the moment it was entered.

pasos: Open Room service › Room service menu.
To add a product, press New item, fill in name, description and price, and press Save.
To change a product, click Edit (or double-click the row), make the changes and press Save.
To stop offering it, click the toggle on its row and confirm.
To see or reactivate inactive items, check "Show inactive items".

elementos.texto: Opens the window to add an item to the menu.
Filters by name or description; Enter or Filter applies the search.
Includes deactivated items in the grid.
Filter applies the search; Clear removes it and hides inactive items.
Name, description, price and status. Edit icon and the toggle to activate or deactivate; double-click also edits.
Required, up to 100 characters. It cannot repeat another item's name.
Optional, up to 200 characters: what the item includes.
Must be greater than zero. It applies to new orders.
If unchecked, the item is inactive and is not offered in orders.
Save validates and saves the item; Cancel closes without changes.

consejos: You need the permission to manage room service items; without it you can only view the menu.
Prefer deactivating rather than renaming an item that has already been sold, so earlier orders remain clear.

temas.resumen: Groups the screens used to maintain the hotel's physical structure (floors, room types and rooms), review the room change history and adjust the general settings.

parrafos: The "Rooms" button in the side menu (HOTEL group) opens Rooms, Room Types and Floors. The "Hotel settings" button opens the check-in and check-out times and the no-show grace period.
Load the data in this order: floors first, then room types (with their capacity and rate) and finally the rooms, which need a floor and a type. You only see the options you have permission for.

temas.resumen: "Manage rooms" screen: lists every room in the hotel with its floor, type, capacity, rate and status, and lets you create, edit or delete rooms.

parrafos: At the top are the title and the "New room" button. Below is the filter bar (number, floor, type and status) with the "Filter" and "Clear" buttons.

The grid shows the Room, Floor, Type, Capacity, Rate per night and Status columns. The status is colored (Available, Reserved, Occupied, Cleaning or Out of service). On the right of each row are the pencil (edit) and trash (delete) icons, visible only if you have the matching permission.
The "New room" button and the pencil open the same window, with the Room number, Floor and Room type fields. Capacity and rate are not entered here: they come from the selected type.

A new room always starts as Available; the status is not edited on this screen but from Room control. If the room has confirmed or in-progress reservations, the type is locked and a notice explains why.

You can only delete a room that never had reservations (not even in the history). Otherwise the trash icon is grey and, if you click it, the system suggests setting the room out of service from Room control.

pasos: Open Rooms from the "Rooms" button in the side menu.
To find a specific room, type its number or choose a floor, type or status and press "Filter".
To create one, press "New room".
Enter the Room number (up to 10 characters, unique) and choose the Floor and the Room type.
Press "Save": the window closes and the grid is refreshed.
To change data, click the row's pencil; to delete it, click the trash icon and confirm.

elementos.texto: Opens the creation window. It only appears if you are allowed to create rooms.
Type the full number or part of it to search for rooms. It is applied when you press "Filter".
Limit the list to one floor or one room type. "All" removes the filter.
Shows only rooms in one status: Available, Reserved, Occupied, Cleaning or Out of service (the same statuses as in Room control).
"Filter" reloads the grid with the selected filters. "Clear" removes all filters and shows every room.

Lists the rooms with floor, type, capacity, rate per night and status (colored). Click the pencil to edit or the trash icon to delete; a grey trash icon means the room has reservations and cannot be deleted.
Room identifier (for example 101). It is required, accepts up to 10 characters and cannot be repeated.
Floor where the room is located. Required; floors are managed on the Floors screen.
Defines the capacity and the rate per night. Required. If the room has active reservations (confirmed or in progress) the list is disabled and the notice is shown.
"Save" validates the data and stores the room; if something is missing or the number already exists, it shows the message and stays open. "Cancel" or the X close without saving.

consejos: You need the permission to view rooms to open this screen; creating, editing and deleting rooms are separate permissions.
Create the floors and room types before loading rooms: without them the lists are empty.
If a room is no longer used but had reservations, do not delete it: set it Out of service from Room control to keep its history.
To change a room's rate, edit its type in Room types: the change applies to every room of that type.

temas.resumen: Manages the room categories (for example Single, Double or Suite) with their capacity and rate per night, which every room of that type inherits.

parrafos: At the top are the "Room types" title and the "New type" button. The filter bar lets you search by name, description, capacity and a rate range (Rate from / Rate to).
The grid shows Name, Description, Capacity, Rate per night and the number of Rooms of each type, with the edit and delete icons at the end of each row.

Capacity is the maximum number of guests (1 to 99) and is used when searching availability and when changing rooms. The rate per night is the price applied to new reservations of that type; reservations already recorded keep the rate they were made with.
A type with rooms assigned cannot be deleted (the trash icon is grey): first move those rooms to another type or delete them.

pasos: Open Room Types from the "Rooms" button in the side menu.
Press "New type" (or the pencil on a row to edit an existing one).
Enter the Name (required, unique, up to 50 characters) and, optionally, a Description of up to 200 characters.
Set the Capacity (guests) and the Rate per night (greater than 0).
Press "Save" to store it and return to the list.
To delete a type with no rooms, press the trash icon and confirm.

elementos.texto: Opens the window to create a room type. It only appears if you are allowed to create types.
Find the types whose name or description contains the text entered.
Shows the types with exactly that capacity. It must be a whole number; otherwise a warning is shown.
Limits the list to types whose rate per night is between both values. You can fill in just one; dot or comma are accepted as decimal separator.
"Filter" applies the filters entered; "Clear" removes them and shows every type again.
Shows each type with its capacity, rate and number of rooms assigned. The pencil edits and the trash icon deletes; a grey trash icon means the type has rooms.
Type name, required and unique (up to 50 characters). It is the name shown on reservations and reports.
Free text to describe the type (beds, view, amenities). Up to 200 characters.
Maximum number of guests, from 1 to 99.
Price per night for the type; it must be greater than 0. The arrows change it in steps of 100.
"Save" validates and stores the type (it warns if the name already exists). "Cancel" or the X close without saving.

consejos: You need the permission to view room types; creating, editing and deleting types are separate permissions.
Changing the rate does not modify existing reservations: it only affects reservations recorded from then on.
The Predictive analysis suggests a rate for each type based on the forecast occupancy: use it as a reference before updating prices.

temas.resumen: Manages the hotel floors (number and name) to which rooms are assigned.

parrafos: At the top are the "Floors" title and the "New floor" button. Below are the Number and Name filters with the "Filter" and "Clear" buttons.
The grid shows Number, Name and the number of Rooms on each floor, with the edit and delete icons.
The floor number is a whole number and cannot be repeated (for example 0 for the ground floor, 1, 2...). The name is required and accepts up to 50 characters.
A floor with rooms assigned cannot be deleted; its trash icon is grey.

pasos: Open Floors from the "Rooms" button in the side menu.
Press "New floor" or the pencil on a row to edit.
Enter the Floor number (whole number, unique) and the Floor name.
Press "Save".
To delete a floor with no rooms, press the trash icon and confirm.

elementos.texto: Opens the window to create a floor. It only appears if you are allowed to create floors.
Find floors by number or by part of the name.
"Filter" applies the filters; "Clear" removes them and shows every floor.
Lists the floors with the number of rooms on each. The pencil edits and the trash icon deletes (grey if the floor has rooms).
Unique whole number of the floor. If it is not a valid number or already exists, a warning is shown and nothing is saved.
Descriptive name (for example "Ground floor" or "First floor"). Required, up to 50 characters.
"Save" validates and stores the floor. "Cancel" or the X close without saving.

consejos: You need the permission to view floors; creating, editing and deleting floors are separate permissions.
Floor lists show "number - name": choose short, clear names.

temas.resumen: Defines the general check-in and check-out times and the no-show grace period, values that apply to the whole hotel.

parrafos: Check-in time and Check-out time: these are the times given to the guest on the reservation voucher, invoice and email.

No-show grace period (hours): once this time has passed since the check-in time on the arrival day, confirmed reservations without a check-in are automatically cancelled as no-shows. Decimals are allowed (half-hour steps) between 0 and 999.99.
When you press "Save" the system asks for confirmation because the change affects the whole hotel and the automatic cancellation. "Discard changes" reloads the saved values.
If the database has no configuration loaded, a notice is shown and the buttons are disabled: in that case contact the administrator.

pasos: Open "Hotel settings" from the side menu (HOTEL group).
Choose the Check-in time and the Check-out time.
Adjust the No-show grace period in hours.
Press "Save" and confirm the message.
If you made a mistake before saving, press "Discard changes".

elementos.texto: Time from which the guest can check in. Required; it must be between 00:00 and 23:59.
Latest time for the guest to leave. Required.
Hours to wait after the check-in time before automatically cancelling a confirmed reservation with no check-in. Value between 0 and 999.99, with two decimals.
Asks for confirmation and stores the settings. It is only enabled if you are allowed to modify them and a configuration exists.
Shows the saved values again, discarding what you changed.
Appears when the database has no configuration; in that case nothing can be saved.

consejos: You need the permission to view the hotel settings; to save changes, the permission to modify them.
A grace period of 0 hours cancels reservations as soon as the check-in time passes: allow a reasonable margin for late arrivals.

temas.resumen: Groups the tools to follow the business: the Dashboard with on-screen indicators and the printable Reports, including the predictive occupancy and demand analysis.

parrafos: In the side menu, the ANALYTICS group has the "Dashboard" and "Reports" buttons. The Dashboard shows the current situation and the revenue of a period with cards and charts; Reports produces documents with a preview to print or save as PDF: Bookings report, Services consumed per guest and Predictive analysis.
Each option only appears if you have the matching permission.

temas.resumen: The "Dashboard" gathers the hotel's indicators in four tabs (General, Occupancy, Guests and Services): room status, revenue, today's movement, guests and spending.

parrafos: At the top, five cards with the current status: Available rooms, Occupied rooms, To be cleaned, Under maintenance (out of service) and Occupancy rate.

Below, the "Period income" bar with shortcuts (Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, All time), the From/To dates, "Refresh" and "Generate report". Period income, Average ticket, % cancelled bookings and Cancelled amount are calculated for that period.

The hotel indicators row shows the Average rate (ADR: lodging revenue per night sold), RevPAR (revenue per available room), Period occupancy (nights sold over available nights), Average stay and Share of services (how much of the revenue comes from room service and upgrades).

Further down: "Revenue source" (Booking, Renewal, Room service and Upgrades), "Period payments" (by day, week or month depending on the length of the period), "Payments by method" and "Arrivals by day of the week".
